name: Dromana Beach
signature: A calm bay beach directly below Arthurs Seat — the natural landing point after the Eagle gondola with easy foreshore swimming
editorNote:
Dromana Beach sits at the base of Arthurs Seat and is the natural endpoint of a gondola-and-beach day. The bay water is calm and sheltered, the beach is sandy, and the foreshore strip behind it has the cafes and takeaways that make Dromana a practical base for a Peninsula day trip.

Dromana SLSC patrols through summer and runs a well-regarded Nippers program on Sunday mornings — one of the more relaxed club environments on the bay, with good facilities and a supportive culture for first-time Nippers families.

Not as long or as shallow as Rosebud but more sheltered and less crowded. The view of Arthurs Seat rising directly behind the foreshore is one of those only-on-the-Peninsula moments.
whyWeGo: Arthurs Seat behind you, calm bay water in front — Dromana Beach is the most scenically situated bay beach on the Peninsula.
ifOnlyOneThing: Combine with Arthurs Seat Eagle for a full day — gondola up, swim down.
